# CANDIDEMIA

# Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.

If other yeasts (e.g. Cryptococcus, Histoplasma) are suspected, refer to fungi
section and contact Infectious Diseases for treatment recommendations.

[Fungi](fungi)

Identification and treatment of the source of infection, in addition to
antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of infection. This may include
removal of catheters and draining of abscesses if present. Call Infectious
Diseases for advice.

Follow-up blood cultures should be obtained within 24-48 hours after initiating
antimicrobial therapy. Obtain at least 2, preferably 3 blood culture sets from
different venipuncture sites within a 24-hour period.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for 2 weeks after last negative blood culture, resolution of neutropenia,
and candidemia symptoms have resolved.
